name: Vendor Portal Operator
tagline: Walks the same procurement portal click-path weekly and reports exceptions only
description: Built for procurement portals with no usable API: it walks the same click-path weekly for renewals, seats and purchasing, and comes back only when a human decision is needed. The portal keeps working the way it always has while the routine part stops costing anyone an hour.
author: SpaceX
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
